goal_checks.notes: regionsFromAnnotations reads subtype==='Highlight', flattens every QuadPoints quad into a rect and normalizes it through the supplied viewport's convertToViewportRectangle; a multi-quad annotation is one region with several rects. annotationCandidates fills exact text from the text layer and never imports the OCR seam. annotation-quads.test.ts and import-ladder.test.ts pin the geometry, the Y flip and zero OCR. The 'real Acrobat PDF' fidelity is the deferred human/fixture check, not the parser.

maskFromRgba + connectedBoxes + mergeLineBoxes find a flattened highlight by its ink (HSV bands, S>0.35/V>0.55, drop <8px tall/<20px wide, merge >60% vertical overlap); flattenedCandidates intersects the found box with the text-layer items for exact text. colour-mask.test.ts and import-ladder.test.ts pin it; no OCR is on this path.

scanCandidates runs the same mask, then crops each box and calls the injected recognizer (011's recognizeRegion by default, which crops again to its own rect — RULE-19: crops only) and keeps the raw confidence. import-ladder.test.ts proves the crop passed to the recognizer and the confidence; the 0.70 gate is 011's derived predicate, surfaced per row by the review.

ImportReview renders every region with a checkbox and an editable textarea and commits only the checked rows; the rows are derived from candidates with the reviewer's overrides in state, none selected by default. use-import-review.test.ts proves nothing commits unaccepted, the selected rows commit, and an edit is written. A below-gate row is labelled 'needs correction'.

accept writes the accepted regions in ONE insertHighlights call; insertHighlights uses the new writeRows, which puts N rows and their N outbox ops in one Dexie transaction. highlight-repository.import.test.ts spies on db.transaction and proves exactly one call for 40 highlights, with 40 rows and 40 outbox ops. The accepted rows are layer='group' (RULE-04; RLS enforces leader-only).

cross_check_against_plan.result: matches — frontend (secondary backend), depends on 010 + 011 (both done); the five mini-goals map to g1-g5; it blocks nothing.

matches — rung 1 first (annotations), rung 2 flattened (colour mask + text items), rung 3 scan (crop + Tesseract, confidence-gated); the review screen is mandatory before commit; each region becomes a layer='group' highlight with a slug; RULE-19 (OCR last, crops only) holds.
matches for the client half — the import is one Dexie transaction, not 80; the server fan-out is 001's trigger / 007's channel and is untouched.
matches — highlights.bbox carries the rects (tool 'rect'), extraction is text_layer|ocr, confidence holds the raw OCR value, layer='group' is leader-write; no schema change.

issues_found: The task Gate ('an Acrobat-annotated PDF imports with exact text and zero OCR calls') needs a real annotated PDF fixture; the parser is exercised with faithful annotation objects and the zero-OCR property is structural (rungs 1/2 never import the OCR seam). The end-to-end fixture run is a follow-up.
The colour mask is a pure module; spec §5.4 suggests it runs in a Worker. Moving it is a perf follow-up with no behaviour change (analyze.json NEW-1).
Rung 1's exact text needs a text layer: with none it keeps the annotation's /Contents (or empty) at confidence 1.0, so the mark survives and the review can fill it (analyze.json NEW-3).

The import has no UI entry point wired to a route yet: ImportReview takes candidates as a prop, and the document-view route that would host it still does not exist (the same route gap 009-016 recorded). The ladder and the review are ready for it.
The mask expects an already-rendered raster; the container that rasterizes a page at the right scale (and runs the mask off the main thread) is the wiring follow-up.
